definitions.gloss: close friend, good friend, being on good terms
definitions.explanation: Describes people who get along well and have a friendly, harmonious relationship. Also used as an adjective-like modifier meaning 'friendly' or 'close.'

examples.japanese: あの{二人|ふたり}は{仲良|なかよ}しだ。
{子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}からの{仲良|なかよ}しだ。
examples.english: We've been close friends since childhood.

examples.japanese: {兄弟|きょうだい}なのに{全然|ぜんぜん}{仲良|なかよ}しじゃない。
examples.english: Even though they're siblings, they don't get along at all.

notes:
USAGE: {仲良|なかよ}し has a warm, somewhat childlike or casual tone. It is very common in everyday speech, especially among women and children, and sounds softer than the more neutral {仲|なか}がいい.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仲良|なかよ}しの{友達|ともだち} (a close friend)
- {仲良|なかよ}しグループ (friend group, clique)
- みんなで{仲良|なかよ}く (everyone getting along)

SIMILAR: {仲|なか}がいい is a more neutral, adult way to say "to be on good terms." {仲良|なかよ}し sounds more affectionate and informal.
